name: Ruins of Jubuwal
summary: East of the Gurubashi Arena, Zanzil the Outcast and his followers hold the Ruins of Jubuwal. The old Gurubashi settlement lies in ruins.

sections.title: A Refuge for the Exiled
sections.body:
Jubuwal once belonged to the great Gurubashi civilization. Stone carvings and ivy-covered walls remain beside Stranglethorn Vale’s main road. Now Zanzil the Outcast holds the ruins. The eccentric witch doctor is known for potent concoctions and foul voodoo.

His followers include enthralled ghouls, subjugated naga and renegade trolls. Desperate fugitives shelter beneath the stone arches too. Jon-Jon the Crow and Maury 'Club Foot' Wilkins hide here from 'Sea Wolf' MacKinley, the ruthless debt collector in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Jubuwal located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Jubuwal lie in central Stranglethorn Vale, just east of the Gurubashi Arena. They stand beside the dirt road between northern and southern Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Who controls the Ruins of Jubuwal?
faq.answer: Zanzil the Outcast and his followers hold the ruins. They include brainwashed trolls, reanimated ghouls, allied naga and scoundrels seeking shelter from the law.

faq.q: Why are ghouls and naga working together here?
aliases: why are there ghouls in jubuwal
faq.answer: Zanzil the Outcast uses toxic voodoo mixtures and mind-altering potions to subdue and command those around him. He binds risen undead, naga and trolls into an obedient fighting force.

faq.q: Why are outlaws like Jon-Jon and Maury hiding here?
faq.answer: Jon-Jon the Crow and Maury 'Club Foot' Wilkins fled to Jubuwal to escape 'Sea Wolf' MacKinley. The notorious debt collector operates out of Booty Bay.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can see Jubuwal as a tragic ruin of Gurubashi heritage. Rogues like Zanzil twist the ancestral voodoo.
As a rogue, you can use Jubuwal's shadows and crumbling walls as cover. There, you can ambush outlaws hiding from Booty Bay's bounty hunters.
